findings.conclusion: Window install awaits setWindowLayoutFullScreen(true) before native bar setup and metric-listener initialization. No later source call changes layout-fullscreen false.

Normal loadMainContent awaits install completed. Explicit error fallback can still load content after native install failure; SDK success and current origin facts must not erase this failure boundary.

Reader visibility policy applies orientation/keep-on/status/navigation/indicator with epoch/revision guards; no height, resize, paper fill, offset or cutout rectangle mutation. extendIntoCutout is semantic AppStorage/layout policy, not native window pixel offset API.
Manga current root padtop0, all-edge SYSTEM+CUTOUT expansion and SYSTEM layout-safe ignore. Ordinary app retains status padding.
Manga Shell all-edge expansion and layout-safe ignore, manga underlay overlay suppressed. Text retains its own prior policy.
ImageViewport is first independent full-size sibling; only control docks and indicators consume positive cached status/gesture/cutout insets; image branch receives none.
Scroll/List create space0 and original-aspect Image Fill. List/Scroll native clips are at same full window frame; no authored header, normal padding, top margin or image translation.
No avoid_cutout metadata; module does not opt into automatic cutout avoidance.

officialReference.boundary: Current upstream docs semantics only, not exact device OS source/binary parity. SYSTEM layout safe includes cutout, camera cutout not automatically avoided unless module metadata opts in. Rendering expansion is component-local and not a global paint-origin proof.
